name: After § 52
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 52a. Expresses deep concern over the alleged involvement of circles close to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, namely Timur Mindich and others, in corruption schemes under investigation by the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and over legislation that has been characterised by anti-corruption watchdogs as designed to hinder this investigation, namely law no. 12414; insists that, although this step was later reversed in law no. 13533, a stronger effort is also necessary to fight corruption at the highest levels of politics and government;
